name: Governance Process Type 1 Code
definition: Specifies a type of governance process.

BMIF.name: Comparible Mi FID
BMIF.definition: Product governance procedure is comparable to MiFID II.

NINF.name: No Information
NINF.definition: No information is requested from the issuer.

CMIF.name: Not Mi FID
CMIF.definition: Product governance procedure is not in accordance with MiFID II.

AMIF.name: Pursuant Mi FID
AMIF.definition: Product governance procedure is pursuant to MiFID II.
